hints.title: Substring Inclusion Verification
hints.text: Check each pattern independently to confirm whether it appears contiguously inside the target word.

hints.title: Standard Substring Predicate
hints.text: Use language-native string containment functions (e.g. pattern in word or string.indexOf).

hints.title: Aggregating Successful Matches
hints.text: Count total patterns satisfying the substring containment check and return the tally.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: With patterns length <= 100 and word length <= 100, direct containment checks execute instantaneously.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place containment search uses zero additional auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write clean and concise matching code.
